description: Clean base design, mixed vendors: 24 V +/-10 percent input, D1 TVS (Littelfuse SMAJ family), U1 buck 24 V to 5 V with an EN/UVLO divider (TI), U2 buck 5 V to 3V3 with internal compensation at 2.2 MHz (ADI), U3 synchronous buck 5 V to 1V8 in pulse-skip mode (MPS), FB3 bead filter with an R-C damper on AVDD_1V8 (Murata bead), U6 Ethernet PHY with two-level straps (Microchip), U7 pressure sensor on I2C2 (Bosch). One bug per class planted below; each mutation is the only change from the clean base. Part behavior here is the synthetic design's assumption, not a datasheet claim.

findings.mutation: R11 (U1 EN/UVLO bottom resistor) 10.0k changed to 10.0 ohm.
findings.title: U1 EN/UVLO divider bottom resistor is 10 ohm, converter never enables

findings.mutation: Damper R33 + C34 removed and C33 changed so FB3 with C33 resonates near 2.1 MHz, next to U2's 2.2 MHz.
findings.title: FB3 and C33 resonate next to U2's switching frequency with no damping

findings.mutation: R60 (pull-up) and R61 (pull-down) on the U6 MODE0 strap both marked fitted.
findings.title: U6 PHY MODE0 strap has both pull-up and pull-down fitted
keywords: both|pull up and pull down|mid level

findings.mutation: L4 changed from the example value to 4.7x it and C40 removed, halving COUT; no Cff footprint.
findings.title: U2 internal-compensation buck runs with L and COUT outside every datasheet example

findings.mutation: D1 changed from a 30 V standoff part (SMAJ30A) to a 24 V standoff part (SMAJ24A).
findings.title: D1 standoff 24 V is below the 26.4 V input maximum

findings.mutation: R35 moved so U3 MODE selects forced-continuous; U1 cannot sink and the 5 V rail has no clamp or bleed load.
findings.title: U3 forced-continuous mode returns current into a 5 V rail whose regulator cannot sink
